rust_summary: A block is about to grow into a feature (`native_block_grow_feature`).
doc_summary: A block is about to grow into a feature: `native_block_grow_feature(dimension, pos, feature, cancel)` can cancel or replace the nullable feature key, which starts `None` when vanilla has no feature to place (a lone dark oak sapling, or a key that isn't installed), so a mod may supply one; `level.random()` exposes the growth RNG. Bundles need "hooks": @API:block_grow_feature@.
